title: Lacson: Witnesses may face contempt over impeachment trial ‘mockery’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Panfilo Lacson on Tuesday reminded witnesses that the Senate Impeachment Court has the power to cite them for contempt if they make a “mockery” of its proceedings.…
